tests.name: test_dense_cohort_week_grid
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT (cohort_week, week_number)) = 18 AND MIN(week_number) = 0 AND MAX(week_number) = 8 AS ok FROM cohort_retention

tests.name: test_cohort_denominator_includes_inactive_users
tests.query: SELECT BOOL_AND(cohort_users = 3) AND abs(MAX(CASE WHEN cohort_week = DATE '2026-01-05' AND week_number = 0 THEN retention_rate END) - 2.0 / 3) < 1e-9 AS ok FROM cohort_retention

tests.name: test_users_counted_once_per_week
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN cohort_week = DATE '2025-12-29' AND week_number = 0 THEN retained_users END) = 2 AND MAX(CASE WHEN cohort_week = DATE '2026-01-05' AND week_number = 2 THEN retained_users END) = 1 AS ok FROM cohort_retention

tests.name: test_elapsed_weeks_by_date_not_calendar_weeks
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN cohort_week = DATE '2025-12-29' AND week_number = 1 THEN retained_users END) = 2 AND MAX(CASE WHEN cohort_week = DATE '2026-01-05' AND week_number = 1 THEN retained_users END) = 0 AS ok FROM cohort_retention

tests.name: test_week_8_included_week_9_and_pre_signup_ignored
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN cohort_week = DATE '2025-12-29' AND week_number = 8 THEN retained_users END) = 1 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE week_number > 8 OR week_number < 0) = 0 AS ok FROM cohort_retention
